scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:db
scripts.test:db: npm run guard:test-db && ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_SEED=true vitest run --project database-integration
scripts.test:e2e: npm run guard:test-db && ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_SEED=true playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: npm run guard:test-db && ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_SEED=true playwright test --grep "seeded user can log in and reach the dashboard" --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:wsl: npm run guard:test-db && ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_SEED=true bash scripts/with-playwright-wsl-libs.sh playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:smoke:wsl: npm run guard:test-db && ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_SEED=true bash scripts/with-playwright-wsl-libs.sh playwright test --grep "seeded user can log in and reach the dashboard" --project=chromium
scripts.verify: npm run check:db-workflows && npm run check:migration-chain && npm run check:cage-closure-migration && npm run check:lab-transfer-workflow && npm run check:same-lab-migration && npm run check:same-lab-history && npm run check:command-foundation && npm run check:identity-migration && npm run check:authorization-manifest && npm run prisma:validate && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.verify:e2e: npm run guard:test-db && ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_SEED=true playwright test --reporter=line
scripts.verify:e2e:reuse: npm run guard:test-db && ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_SEED=true E2E_REUSE_EXISTING_SERVER=1 playwright test --reporter=line
scripts.verify:e2e:wsl: npm run guard:test-db && ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_SEED=true bash scripts/with-playwright-wsl-libs.sh playwright test --reporter=line
scripts.verify:e2e:reuse:wsl: npm run guard:test-db && ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_SEED=true E2E_REUSE_EXISTING_SERVER=1 bash scripts/with-playwright-wsl-libs.sh playwright test --reporter=line
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run verify:e2e
scripts.verify:all:wsl: npm run verify && npm run verify:e2e:wsl
scripts.db:prepare:demo: npm run db:migrate && ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_SEED=true npm run db:seed
scripts.db:prepare:empty: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed:empty
